svoicecommands.error.message_too_long: Your voice command message was too long and was truncated (%1$s > %2$s)
svoicecommands.config.title: Voice Commands
svoicecommands.config.option.block_hotba:
When issuing a voice command, this option blocks whether it would actually switch your currently held item or not
This does not affect use of the scroll wheel for slot changing
svoicecommands.config.option.global_pref:
Prefix to include before the command message
If a command is set as the prefix, the message will be sent as a command
svoicecommands.config.option.voicemenu.a:
Add a space between the prefix and the message.
This is useful if your prefix is a command, but may cause issues if the message itself is the command or also apart of the command.
svoicecommands.config.option.voicemenu.u: Override the global prefix for this menu only
svoicecommands.config.option.voicemenu.s: Commands must have a shorthand and a message to appear on the menu and be functional

Short, concise one liner that appears in the voice menu
Set blank to disable
svoicecommands.config.option.voicemenu.m:
The message sent out when the voice command is issued
Set blank to disable
